text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Lucky Lilac's Classic year
finally about to get underway—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: “—And now, please welcome Lucky Lilac, who has brilliantly been chosen as the Best Junior Queen Umamusume!”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone.
I am Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much for selecting me
for such an honorable award."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every year, the URA presents the "URA Awards"
to honor Umamusume who delivered outstanding
performances across various categories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac was set to be honored as
the "Best Junior Queen Umamusume" this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True to its name, this award is presented to the Tiara Umamusume of the Junior Class who has achieved especially outstanding results—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The award winners are decided by a press vote.
This time, Lucky Lilac was chosen by unanimous vote—
a truly proud achievement."
choice_data_list: (...I need to make sure I'm worthy of this too.)
(...I have to make myself worthy, too.)

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text:
To possess such presence in her Classic year already...
There's a delicacy to her movements as well... truly a queen.

text_block_list.name: Participant B
text_block_list.text:
"She's showing great ambition for the Triple Tiara
and has incredible entertainment appeal.
She's truly a glamorous new heroine."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing Lucky Lilac giving her speech on stage with such poise,
she unmistakably has the aura of a true queen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I need to brace myself, mind and body, so that I can stand proudly beside her as her Trainer. The award ceremony became a moment to renew that vow—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: A celebration?
choice_data_list: Right, it's a celebration in honor of your award!
Right, it's a celebration to commemorate winning the award!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, Lucky Lilac had spent
her entire Junior year in a strictly stoic manner."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While keeping both body and mind sharp is important, it is equally crucial to celebrate glory in the moments it comes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I proposed this wishing to properly celebrate
her great achievements right now, combined with a break,
but—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...You're right, Trainer.
I've been pushing myself so hard up until now, and—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"We must celebrate while we still can.
After all, we're going to be even busier this year."
choice_data_list: It's settled. So, what should we do to celebrate?
It's settled, then. So, what kind of celebration should we have?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...In that case,
could you decide for me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I want to do that together. ...Because this award is something the two of us achieved together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing her call it "something we seized together" warms my heart. Just as she wished, the celebration idea that came to mind was—
choice_data_list: Have a blast at the amusement park!
Let's go see a live comedy show.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
An amusement park...! Sounds lovely.
Going all out having fun at a place like that
every once in a while sounds delightful.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I waaaannaa go so badly!!
I wanna ride roller coasters and scream "waaah"
and have tons of fuuun!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Man, I'm gettin' so thrilled...!
I'm definitely gonna enjoy every second of this...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That coaster was
way faster than I imagined...
choice_data_list: Ah... You were shouting quite a bit too, Luck.
Yeah... Luck was screaming quite a bit too, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well of course, that's just the kind of ride it is.
Even I go 'waaah' on it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-san. Let's ride something else next.
We're going to play our hearts out today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I fully enjoyed the amusement park
alongside a cheerful Lucky Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! That is a classic way to celebrate.
Do you know of any good places?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Sukiyaki sounds lovely—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I wanna eaaaaaaat it—!!! I wanna eat sukiyaki so badlyyyyyy!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(A fancy sukiyaki means *that*, right?!
Like where the staff cooks it right in front of ya!
And each slice of meat is ginormous?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Man, I'm gettin' so hyped!
I gotta make sure my stomach's completely empty on the day!
And I'm definitely not eatin' beef the day before!!)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the meat is ready,
so please dip it in the egg and enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Mmm~~~~!! Sooo goooood~~!!
I'm gonna melt right along with the meat~~~!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Haaah... celebration meals are the best...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Thank you so much
for bringing me here today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac looked so happy, making it a meal that truly made me glad I took the time to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, watching a live performance as a celebration
is pretty unusual, but fun.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Still, I think it's a great idea. There's nothing quite like live comedy, after all."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, I'm suuuper happy...!!
I haven't been able to go to any live shows lately, so my craving for comedy's been secretly through the roof...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That atmosphere you can only experience live...!
I shall savor every last drop of it!)

text_block_list.name: Funny Man
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, I admit it.
It was 0% you, 100% my fault.

text_block_list.name: Straight Man
text_block_list.text:
You didn't acknowledge it one bit!!
How brazen can you get?!

text_block_list.name: Funny Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad.
How about fifty-fifty then?

text_block_list.name: Straight Man
text_block_list.text:
"No, why are you pinning the blame on me in the first—
Wait, your pronunciation is amazing, what the heck?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Ah, live comedy really is the best. And what's more—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Huh, I feel more at ease than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Lucky Lilac thoroughly enjoyed the comedy show, bursting into joyful laughter again and again—
